name: Active Recovery Spin
focus: Flush legs, parasympathetic recovery — deliberately easy

steps.description: Free spin, easy cadence, no pressure
Z1 upper / Z2 floor, cadence 88-95 rpm, HR <150 bpm. Drop to 70-88W if HR won't settle below 150.
Easy spin, cadence falls to ~70 rpm

name: Upper Body + Anti-Rotation Core (Shoulder-Safe)
focus: Back and core strength, light shoulder activation, knee-sparing — no heavy leg work
notes: 2 rounds: 8x dumbbell bent-over row 11kg per side, 10x TRX inverted row, 12x dumbbell farmer's carry 8kg per hand (20m), 10x Pallof press per side (light band), 20x dead bug (slow, controlled). 60-90s rest between rounds. Shoulder work light and pain-free only. No spinal flexion under load.

steps.description: Arm circles forward/back, band pull-aparts (light), 10x bodyweight scapular push-ups, cat-cow stretches
8x dumbbell bent-over row 11kg per side → 10x TRX inverted row → 12x dumbbell farmer's carry 8kg per hand (20m) → 10x Pallof press per side → 20x dead bug (slow, controlled)
Rest between rounds — walk around, breathe, check posture
Chest opener stretch (doorway or arms behind back), shoulder rolls, child's pose — hold each 30-45s
